steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience to sit for the PMP exam. Review PMI's credential handbook to verify you meet the baseline requirements for your background. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can clarify eligibility questions before you enroll in the bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led course covers the PMBOK Guide, exam domains, and real-world scenarios across a condensed schedule. All sessions are online, so you can study from anywhere in Reno while maintaining your work commitments.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, file your PMP application directly with PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process to ensure accuracy and on-time submission. PMI reviews applications within a standard timeframe before authorizing you to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and study materials to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your exam through Pearson Vue at a local or remote testing center. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before you sit for the rigorous, multiple-choice assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Your PMP certification is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or teaching in project management. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to help you stay current and maintain your credential status.
